title: Modernizar la sociedad
goal: Read how railroads and telegraph lines were built to connect export zones to ports rather than the interior, and how positivism's "order and progress" justified the process.

items: Explain what liberal governments built across the region in the late nineteenth century.
Describe the real pattern behind where railroad lines were routed.
Explain what accompanied the railroads and what it changed.
Name the philosophy that justified this modernization, and its slogan.
Use the gerund to describe one action unfolding alongside or as a result of another.
